test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) AH – CK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/291fb7edc7799f6fa22b4ceeb5100f455e0a8792336f69faa7f288ce151e3313.png] 

Option 2) KR – NU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03d9c4e82be9cc38d3dc97764e13695765837a2c6585742e81bab0db4007c8c0.png] 

Option 3) NU – PX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46ff0b0a897e1c87cb0d2e3bc45565d5dd7995326a6d4847ded215d2a7dde230.png] 

Option 4) EL – GO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/170edde6eee87ef2316640e2a6f92f33b75f2d894cf6ff9546afc883ce45c448.png] 

Thus, out of all 'KR – NU' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
